changes_vs_current: Monopoly #1 stays; Checkers added at #2 (was absent) and Chess 3 (was 3); Clue 6 to 4, Scrabble 4 to 5; Catan 2 to 14, Ticket to Ride, Codenames, Pandemic, Carcassonne, Operation, Guess Who, Chutes? (kept) dropped. UNO (22.75) and JENGA (23.8) fall out under the literal rule because only the Cribbage survey (where Uno is #2 'still played') covers them; YouGov did not ask and they are card/stacking games absent from search/sales lists. Added Checkers, Pictionary, Rummikub, Mancala, Yahtzee, Go, Trouble, Mahjong, Parcheesi.
confidence: medium for ranks 1-10 (YouGov poll plus 3 other sources agree on Monopoly, Checkers, Chess, Clue, Scrabble), low for 11-24 (they rest on search and sales sources). Note the missing-rank rule penalizes Uno/Jenga unfairly; if you want them kept, they are the next-best candidates after Parcheesi (Uno 22.75, Jenga 23.8, Ticket to Ride 22.0, Codenames 22.75). Ranker 'best board games' (fan vote) returned 401, BoardGameGeek is a hobbyist audience so was not used.
